canonical_statement: Provisional source-faithful root: a nonnegative solution of a uniformly elliptic second-order linear equation in nondivergence form with measurable leading coefficients satisfies an interior Harnack estimate, bounding its supremum on a concentric interior ball by a universal constant times its infimum there.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: finite-dimensional real Euclidean space of positive dimension; measurable symmetric matrix field; real-valued function on a ball. Exact Lean types and universes are open.
quantifiers: measurable coefficient field A on the unit ball
nonnegative solution u on the unit ball
an estimate constant C depending only on n, lambda, and Lambda
hypotheses: A is uniformly elliptic almost everywhere with constants lambda and Lambda
u solves trace(A(x) * Hessian(u)(x)) = 0 in the selected solution sense
conclusion: supremum of u on the concentric half ball is at most C times its infimum there
